:::{#thm-level-set-points}
#### A level set is the set of points where the function takes the value

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$,
and let $c$ be a [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers).
The [level set](#def-level-set) of $f$ at $c$ is the [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) of points
where $f$ takes the value $c$:

$$
\levelsetof{c}{f} = \cb{\vx \in \reals^p : f(\vx) = c}.
$$

:::

::: proof

Unfold the [preimage](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-preimage):

$$
\ba
\levelsetof{c}{f}
&= \preimage{f}{\cb{c}}
&& \text{(@def-level-set)}
\\
&= \cb{\vx \in \reals^p : f(\vx) \in \cb{c}}
&& \text{(definition of the preimage)}
\\
&= \cb{\vx \in \reals^p : f(\vx) = c}.
&& \text{(} \cb{c} \text{ has the one element } c \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
